Header: Stenchaetothrips biformis Sinhala- Pela mekka/ tamil-Panippoochchi

Prevention: Use of recommended seed rates(for long grain rice- Broadcasting- 100kg/Ha, Trans planting- 50 kg/ha, Parachute – 10-12 kg/ha)
Use of enough compost where possible.
Monitoring: Start random observation after crop establishment.
To monitor, move wet hand across top of plants and count thrips who stick to hand
Observe for rolled edges of leaves and drying from tips.
Damaged leaves have silvery streaks and translucent marks.
Both the larva and adult fold the leaf longitudinally to form a protective chamber.
Typical symptoms also include stunting and wilting or scorching.
In severe infestations, seedlings may be killed.
Direct Control: Flood field for two -three days if population is high.
Impound water and drag banana logs.
Restrictions: Thiamethoxam 70%WS 20g/500ml water/100kg seed. (In late planting seed treatment is strongly advisable.)
Apply foliar sprays when 50% of leaves/ hill show damage symptoms
